about: FoodBlock 1.6: every closed list and grammar in protocol.md, for code to load. Where protocol.md states a list, it matches this file exactly. Older words are read through aliases.json, never written.

stop.occurrences: { occurrences: [start times] }: named occurrences of a standing promise

where.values: decimal strings; radius is an amount in m

aliases.shapes_order: the rules for type.kind, then for type, each in listed order; each `when` is tested on the block as read so far
aliases.types_order: per-type rows, then every-type rows (`*`); a name with no row, written base.rest, reads by `types_dotted`

grammar_notes.duration: Written without lookahead so every regex engine runs it.
grammar_notes.time: The pattern is the shape; the value must also be a real calendar instant (no 30 February).
grammar_notes.date: The pattern is the shape; the value must also be a real calendar date.

refusals.about: Every refusal is { hash, code, detail }: code from these lists, detail free text for people. block: why a node refuses a block's bytes (final for those bytes). fold: why a fold counts a block for nothing. message: why a node refuses a pull or push. A block breaking several rules gets one entry per rule found, in this order.

block.not_canonical: not in canonical form (key order, NFC, nulls)
block.bad_hash: a hash sent with it is not the hash of its canonical bytes
block.bad_signature: its signature opens with no key of its author
block.void_key: signed by a key of its author that does not speak for it: void, frozen, or rotated past last_good
block.size_limit: its canonical body is over limits.block_bytes (a sealed copy's block, once opened)
block.after_limit: refs.after names more than limits.after_heads heads
block.float: a number with a fraction or exponent in signed content
block.grammar: a hash, key, signature, salt, nonce, confidence or role ref outside its grammar
block.time: a time, date or duration outside its grammar
block.calendar: a time or date in the right shape that is not a real calendar instant
block.shape: an amount, money, price, range, mark, share, split, when, where or reveal without its keys
block.unknown_type: a type that is not one of the seven
block.undeclared_ref: a ref key neither shared nor declared by its schema
block.undeclared_field: a state field neither its type's base field nor declared by its schema
block.bad_genesis: a genesis with author, prev, after or seq, not public, missing a genesis field, or not signed by its own key
block.audience: an audience that is neither public nor a sorted list of commitments
block.chain: a seq or prev that does not fit its key's chain
block.at_before_after: its at is earlier than a block it names in after
block.no_history: a block without seq from a 1.6 identity
block.history_closed: a block without seq outside an older identity's closed history
block.not_own_rotation: a rotation signed by neither the key it replaces nor the recovery key
block.recovery_scope: the recovery key signed something other than a key grant or a defeats of a successor's trigger
block.status_not_answer: a status on a block that neither answers nor updates its author's own
block.bad_status: a status not in answers, or stopped without a stop from stop
block.not_a_side: a promise, or a deal block, signed by neither side nor an agent under a side's live grant
block.deal_not_named: an answer or counter in a deal that does not name the first promise in refs.for
block.lines: a line without an id unique in the promise, a top-level price or quantity beside lines, or refs.what not the lines' what
block.wider_than_parent: a child grant's scope or depth wider than its parent's on any field
block.not_receiver: a grant passed on by someone other than its parent's receiver
block.scope_until: a grant others act under without scope.until, or a key, member, successor or operator grant with one

fold.not_a_side: signed by neither side nor an agent under a side's live grant
fold.open_offer_counter: a counter to an open offer: it ends nothing; only the author ends an open offer
fold.not_live: acts under a grant that is not live, or outside its scope
fold.no_role: signs as a circle without a role in its signers, in the circle's fold of its causal past
fold.not_counted: a settling block the receiver has not accepted and no confirmer the grounds name has confirmed
fold.equivocation: one of a pair that do not see each other: proof, counted for nothing
fold.expired: an accept that reached the offerer after expires, on the offerer's clock

message.bad_signature: the message is not signed by the signer it names
message.window: its at is outside limits.signed_window of the node's clock
message.not_admitted: the node's admission rule does not admit it

identity.input: an id and the blocks held

output.signed_by_author: { hash: true when the block is the id's }
output.frozen: the frozen keys among them, sorted
output.operators: authors of live operator grants naming it, sorted

promise_stage.input: a first promise and the blocks held; the reader's clock

output.stage: offered, asked, expired, declined, stopped, accepted, underway, done or reversed
output.accept: the binding accept's hash, or null
output.takers: [{ who, request, allocation, quantity }] on an open offer, in causal order
output.forks: allocations that do not see the one before, sorted
output.lines: [{ id, needed, moved }], id null without lines
output.total: money the price comes to, or null
output.paid: money counted to the from side, or null

circle_state.input: a circle and the blocks held

may_act_as.input: a block, a circle, a role or none
may_act_as.output: true when the author holds the role (or one of the circle's signers) in the circle's fold of the block's causal past

members_then.input: a block and a circle or circle#role
members_then.output: the member or holder ids, sorted

where_now.output: the places (hashes), sorted; empty when none is known

output.owner: an id, or null after a transfer to an open receiver
output.transfers: the counted ownership transfers, in order
output.conflict: the crossing pair, sorted, or null

successor_state.input: a successor grant, arrivals on this node, the reader's clock

output.events: the standing event observes, one per witness, sorted
output.cancelled: the event observes the person defeated in time, sorted
output.since: the arrival of the needed-th event, or null
output.fired: true once the clock reaches fires

output.epoch: the current epoch; 0 is the circle actor's key
output.keys: the encryption keys of the epoch's counted rekeys, sorted

counted_in.input: a ballot result, a commitment, the named counter
counted_in.output: true when the result is signed by that counter and lists the commitment in counted

chain.head: hash of the latest block
chain.equivocations: pairs of hashes at one seq, each pair sorted
chain.broken: hashes whose prev does not name the block before
chain.ok: true when there are no gaps, equivocations or broken links

next_link.seq: the next seq for the key
next_link.prev: the hash of the key's previous block, or of the block that brought the key in

keypairs.note: How vectors and SDKs pass keys: hex. Private keys never appear in blocks.

notes_push_for: for maps a sealed copy's hash to a list of ids
